tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The selection will be on the basis of highest rates quoted per month in Rs.(including taxes). The bidder shall quote his/her offer per month including taxes.
The Tender/Bids shall be submitted through e-procurement portal only. (http://kppp.karnataka.gov.in.)
The period of License is 03(Three) years from the date of signing of agreement

Prohibition Clause for Black Listed /Default Licensees / Disqualification: The licensees who have been black listed or terminated or a defaulter in any departments of State Governments or Government of India or in any public sector undertakings or in any corporate for any reason what so ever are not eligible for participating in the tender
The space of accommodation is for Parking purpose under as is where is basis condition only
